settings_language_desc: Language for the app interface. "System" follows your OS language and falls back to English when it is not supported.
settings_density_desc: Adjusts padding in the sidebar, lists, and buttons. "Compact" fits more items on screen (text size is unchanged).
settings_measure_desc: Limits the preview content width and centers it. The wider the window, the longer each line gets and the easier it is to lose your place. The width value lives under Aa in the Preview toolbar, next to text size — this switch only turns it on and off. Tables shrink to fit, and content that cannot shrink further (such as code blocks) gets its own horizontal scroll. Exported HTML follows this setting too.
settings_backup_desc: When you rename a note, snapshots of the affected notes are saved inside the vault under .lapis/link-rewrite-backup/. Anything beyond this count is deleted oldest-first. (Range {min}–{max})
settings_mcp_desc: Lets Claude Code and Desktop query this vault's index through lapis_query. Blocked by default — you have to allow it.
settings_mcp_warn: ⚠️ The server process is spawned by the Claude client — blocking here only refuses queries, it cannot stop the process from starting. To stop it entirely, remove mcpServers.lapis from ~/.claude.json.
settings_mcp_paths_split: ⚠️ This build writes {writes} but MCP reads {reads}. Turning it on here will not reach MCP.
settings_git_desc: Commits vault changes automatically so you keep a history (see History at the bottom of a note). Excludes paths like _memories and only creates a local .git.
settings_git_started: Version control started — changes are committed automatically.
settings_git_start_failed: Could not start — check the console
settings_recency_desc: Which timestamp the palette's recently changed list reads. File mtime moves whenever an outside tool touches the file; frontmatter date is what a person wrote.
settings_reindex_desc: Rebuilds the search, tag, and relation indexes from scratch, ignoring the cache. Use it when you changed documents or properties in bulk outside the app and search has not caught up. Changes normally propagate on their own, so you rarely need this. Pressing it closes Settings and shows progress in the sidebar (search is briefly blocked until it finishes; reading keeps working).
settings_usage_desc: Records which commands you run and from where, and where errors happen — on this machine only. It is the evidence for deciding what to fix next.
settings_usage_warn: ⚠️ Nothing is ever sent anywhere. It is stored outside the vault in the app data folder and can be cleared at any time.
settings_usage_dropped: ⚠️ {count} line(s) dropped at the size cap.
settings_css_desc: Override the design tokens and data-lapis hooks to restyle the app.
settings_css_panic: ⚠️ If this makes the app unusable, press ⌘⇧⌥C (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+C) to switch it off. If the app will not start at all, run lapis css --off in a terminal.
settings_css_hooks_note: Only these hooks and the design tokens in app.css are kept stable. Internal class names may change without notice.
settings_theme_color_desc: A colour preset layered over dark. Contrast is held at the default.
settings_theme_color_note: Custom CSS still overrides individual tokens on top of a preset.
page_conflict_body: It looks like another tool modified this note while you were editing it here (you have unsaved changes).
page_conflict_question: How do you want to handle it?
page_conflict_keep_mine_desc: The next save overwrites the external changes
page_conflict_use_external_desc: Discard what you are editing and load the external version
page_debug_badge: Debug build — not the release app
page_stats_title: Words · characters (excluding spaces) · estimated reading time
page_sidebar_resize: Resize sidebar (double-click to restore the default)
page_pane_resize: Drag to resize · double-click to restore
page_context_resize: Resize context panel (double-click to restore the default)
page_welcome_placeholder:
# Pick a note

Click a note in the sidebar on the left, or press **Cmd+N** to create one.
page_menu_reveal_desc: Open the current note selected in Finder
page_menu_copy_path_desc: Copy the absolute path of the current note (⌘⇧C)
page_menu_copy_rich_desc: Copy as rich text (keeps formatting for Confluence, email, …)
page_menu_save_html_desc: Save the preview as a self-contained HTML file (CSS and images included)
page_confirm_trash: Move the note "{name}" to the Trash?
page_path_copy_title:
Click to copy the absolute path (⌘⇧C)
{path}
section_resize_title: Drag to resize · double-click for automatic
sidebar_pick_vault_hint: Pick a vault folder and your .md files show up here.
sidebar_lens_title: Group by a frontmatter field value (folder tree is "Folder")
sidebar_first_time_hint: First time here? Start with a sample note that shows the shortcuts and wikilinks.
sidebar_menu_reindex_desc: Rebuild the search, tag, and relation indexes, ignoring the cache
props_add_title: Add a frontmatter field to this note
props_tag_filter_title: Filter the sidebar by this tag
props_notice: Editing properties may normalize comments and some whitespace in the frontmatter.
props_yaml_error: This note's frontmatter is not valid YAML, so it was left untouched. Fix it in the editor (⌘E) first — saving over it would discard the existing properties.
props_validate_topic_flat: topic cannot be nested — a single kebab word
reading_measure_wider: Wider content (widen past the end for unlimited)
palette_ime_swapped: No match — showing results for “{query}” (typed with the Korean IME on).
palette_stem_matched: No match — showing results with word endings folded (e.g. “write” finds “writing”).
rendered_sort_hint: Click to sort (source → asc → desc). The file is not modified
alert_rewrite_failed: The note was renamed, but citations in other notes were not updated.
alert_conflict_failed: Could not read the external change. The conflict is still open.
linkrw_backup_note: Applying backs the originals up to .lapis/link-rewrite-backup/<timestamp>/.
linkrw_backup_hint: If something goes wrong you can restore manually from the backup folder.
nb_no_direct_citation: No direct citation in the body
nb_commit_no_change: This note did not change in this commit
nb_commit_restore_hint: The file is not modified. Read the old content and move over what you need.
linkrw_summary: {notes} notes · total {total} references will be updated
palette_hint_full: Type to search. <kbd>></kbd> commands · <kbd>#</kbd> tags · <kbd>:</kbd> facets
tags_prefix_all: Show every note under this prefix
git_banner_body: This vault is not under version control. Start it and changes get recorded automatically.
filters_empty: No notes in this vault have doc_kind or topic metadata.
filters_empty_hint: Available once the 4-key frontmatter schema is in use.
filters_pick_hint: Pick a filter to see matching notes.
fav_empty: Right-click a file → 📌 Pin to add it.
outline_empty_hint: Add a heading and the outline shows up here.
newnote_create_failed: Could not create — a file with that name already exists, or the path is invalid
newnote_template_hint: Markdown files in the vault's .lapis/templates/ appear here. Names wrapped in double braces — title, date, time, datetime — are filled in; unknown names are left alone.
assets_open_title: {name} — open in the default system viewer
mermaid_convert_failed: This diagram could not be converted to PNG.
mermaid_save_failed: Could not save the PNG file.
export_html_convert_failed: Could not convert the preview to HTML.
export_html_save_failed: Could not save the HTML file.
export_images_missing_body:
Could not embed {failed} image(s) in the file.
The other {inlined} were included normally. See the console for details.
table_no_columns: No columns selected — add one from the Columns menu
cmd_broken_links: Vault diagnostics (broken links, no backlinks, duplicate tags)
brokenlinks_hint: Body wikilinks and markdown links only. Frontmatter cross-refs are excluded: by design a value counts as a relation only when it resolves, so auditing them would flag every ordinary scalar.
hygiene_orphans_empty: Every note has at least one backlink.
hygiene_orphans_hint: Notes nothing links to. A high outgoing count usually means an entry point, which is fine.
hygiene_tags_hint: Candidates only. To merge, use Rename tag from the Command Palette — it previews, backs up, and rolls back on failure.
hygiene_ambiguous_hint: Several notes share this name. Links inside a document go to the nearest one, but giving the name to the CLI is rejected.
hygiene_unlinked_hint: Places that name another note without linking to it. Ambiguous names, code, frontmatter, and sources already connected to the target are left out. Turning one into a link is done by hand.
hygiene_unlinked_failed: Could not read the note bodies.
hygiene_props_hint: Values that have split apart on an axis you can filter by (doc_kind, topic, and the like). A split axis makes a query on it find half of what it should — with no error. Free-form values show up here too; that does not make them wrong.
hygiene_tasks_hint: Collects - [ ] from note bodies. Fenced code is skipped — counting examples as tasks would make the list untrustworthy.
hygiene_changes_norepo: This vault is not a git repository. You can start one in Settings → Vault.
hygiene_changes_hint: Recent commits across the whole vault. Per-note history lives in the Relations tab of the context panel.
hygiene_tasks_failed: Could not read the note bodies.
hygiene_decay_summary: {count} say they are done but still have unchecked items
hygiene_decay_hint: A note whose frontmatter says it is finished while its body still holds - [ ]. Both statements are the note's own, so this is counted, not inferred. Notes with no status, or a status that is not in the vocabulary, are left out — a checklist is supposed to stay unchecked.
grep_placeholder: Literal text or regex — press Enter to run
grep_hint: BM25 search (⌘⇧F) matches tokens; this matches the string itself. Use it when the wording differs from what you remember. Clicking a result opens in-document search with the same pattern.
grep_replace_none: The replace engine found no matches.
grep_replace_warn_self: ⚠️ The replacement matches the pattern again — running it twice grows it twice.
grep_replace_warn_fm: ⚠️ {count} of them are inside frontmatter — this can break the YAML.
grep_replace_warn_skew: ⚠️ In {count} notes the search found matches but the replace engine did not. Search uses Rust and replace uses JS regex, so they can differ — those notes are left alone.
grep_replace_hint: This cannot be undone. A backup is written first, and a failed write is rolled back.
tagrename_merge_warn: That tag already exists — the two will be merged into one. This cannot be undone.
tagrename_children_note: Child tags move too: renaming tech to stack turns tech/svelte5 into stack/svelte5.
tagrename_backup_note: Affected notes are backed up to .lapis/link-rewrite-backup/ before writing. A failed write is rolled back automatically.
settings_chrome_hint: When on, the app bar doubles as the title bar. Turning it off restores the native title bar.
settings_chrome_restart: Some window behavior only settles after a restart.
settings_density_hint: Spacing only — text size does not change.
settings_motion_hint: Spinners and progress bars keep moving on Minimal.
empty_desc: Pick a folder that holds your Markdown notes. Lapis reads it in place — nothing is copied and nothing leaves this machine.
empty_local_only: Notes stay on your filesystem. There is no sync and no network code in this app.
settings_usage_hide_title: Turn on only when pasting somewhere public. Applies to the summary (.md) only.
settings_usage_raw_note: The raw log is never redacted — redacting means parsing it, and parsed is no longer raw.
hygiene_stale_empty: No note has gone six months untouched.
hygiene_stale_summary: {count} notes have sat unchanged for six months.
hygiene_stale_hint: Not a list of things to fix — a list of things to look at again. Uses whichever is later: the file's modified time or the frontmatter date.
wikilink_ambiguous: {count} notes share this name — goes to the nearest: {paths}
